studies.title: The peach
studies.caption: Peaches surround a hard stone with soft flesh. Farmers selected larger, sweeter fruit over many generations before the crop spread west from China.
studies.prompt: Botanical study of Prunus persica fruiting twig with narrow lanceolate finely serrated leaves, two modest fuzzy blush peaches and a cut peach below showing deeply ridged stone. Soft lower Yangtze orchard setting, no blossoms required alongside ripe fruit, no smooth nectarine skin.
